title: Complete implementation
adaptationNote: The unchanged shared course_test.hpp from Book II B02-L0110 is placed first; the local include is removed. CHECK stays active in optimized builds.

guide.problem: Keep unique values or counts with clear ordering.
guide.design: A set keeps keys once; a map associates each key with a value. An unordered container is better when sorted traversal is not required.
guide.invariant: Ordering must be a consistent strict comparison; frequency totals equal the input count.
guide.failure: A comparison that says a<a is true breaks ordering. Iterating an unordered container cannot promise sorted output.
guide.trace: For 3,1,3, a sorted set visits 1,3 and a count map records 1:1,3:2.
guide.maintenance: State whether order is part of the external contract before changing containers.
guide.scope: This panel connects this listing to its chapter’s problem. Short demonstrations illustrate one part; the chapter’s complete implementation and invariant labs test the broader contract.

experiment: Predict one boundary or tie case, then change this listing and trace the affected state. For 3,1,3, a sorted set visits 1,3 and a count map records 1:1,3:2.
